title: New Website
description: Our brand new site (which you're on currently)

blocks.markdown: Hey everyone, just wanted to let you all know that we're finally done with the new website, and are officially launching it today! I know a lot of different versions of FMHY have been made over the years, but we've put a ton of effort into this one, and honestly feel like its the best version to date.
We really hope you enjoy it, and if you have any issues or suggestions feel free to leave them in the comments here, or by using the new feedback system built into the site.
